statement: In a preregistration, write every commit of another repository as owner/repo@sha, never as a bare hash. A preregistration cannot be edited after it is pushed, so a citation the checker misreads can only be corrected by an erratum. Cejel #592's preregistration named the corpus pins of two public rows, the clones the re-read times were measured on, as bare short hashes in a sentence that also said preregistration. The cited-commits check read them as Cejel commits that resolve to nothing, and failed. Two other-repository entries in the citation errata register were needed, though one keystroke at writing time would have avoided them. Rules: before pushing a preregistration, run the cited-commits check in pull-request mode on its commit; qualify each external hash with its owner/repo, taken from the corpus; keep a generated file's existing formatting when adding to it, and confirm that the diff shows additions only.
